biotools.summary: PUPpy is a Python pipeline for designing microbe- and group-specific primers within a given microbial community, enabling the detection and quantification of microbial DNA at substrain-level resolution. It offers both a graphical user interface and terminal commands, requiring only coding sequence files as input.
